reasoning: This question asks whether the Fed's mortgage-backed securities (MBS) holdings will increase between October 11 and October 18, 2026 - a 7-day period. The data is updated weekly on Wednesdays. The Fed's MBS holdings are influenced by: (1) scheduled principal repayments and prepayments (which reduce holdings), (2) reinvestment decisions, and (3) policy changes. Since the 2008 financial crisis, the Fed has generally allowed MBS to run off rather than actively purchasing. Without major policy shifts, MBS holdings typically decline or remain relatively stable week-to-week due to natural runoff. A 7-day increase would require either active purchases or unusually low prepayments. Given the Fed's current stance of not actively expanding its balance sheet and the typical runoff pattern, a week-to-week increase is unlikely but not impossible.
